summary: This bill renames the Great Falls Scenic Overlook Trail Bridge and Overlook Park within Paterson Great Falls National Historical Park as the Bill Pascrell, Jr. Scenic Overlook Trail Bridge and Bill Pascrell, Jr. Overlook Park, and requires all U.S. government references to use the new names.
